div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 预约服务系统 · 17 条业务生命周期

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
订单生命周期
pending → paid → confirmed → serving
→ completed → reviewed
pending/paid → cancelled
paid → refunding → refunded
锁技师 3 分钟 · 退款店长→财务两级审批

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
拼团活动
ongoing → joined → group_paid
ongoing → full → closed
joined → cancelled（未成团）
Redis NX 防超卖 · 拼团价=原价×discount_percent

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
秒杀活动
published → ongoing → sold_out / ended
ongoing → seckill_order
行锁 stock-1 · 取消订单不回补库存

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
满减活动
draft → published → used / ended
券后金额≥threshold 自动减免，取最大额 · 拼团/秒杀跳过

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
支付回调
创建支付记录 → 统一下单 → 前端调起
→ 微信回调验签 → 状态 paid → 双端通知

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
会员卡
active → used_up（次卡次数用完）
active → expired（月卡/VIP 到期）
active ⇄ frozen（违规冻结/解冻）

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
优惠券
draft → published → claimed
claimed → used / expired
published → ended（库存领完/到期下架）

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
优惠券转赠
available → transferred（8位码 7 天有效）
→ claimed / expired（懒判定恢复原券）
Redis NX + 行锁防双花 · 同一券仅可转赠一次

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
积分过期
earned（expires_at = now + 365天）
→ used / expired
PointsExpiryTimer 60s 扫描 · 三层幂等

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
余额/积分转账
validating → locked → completed / failed
client_token 重复 → idempotent
Redis NX 30s + 双方行锁（user_id 升序防死锁）

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
电子发票
pending → issued（invoice_no + issued_at）
pending → rejected（reject_reason）
uk_order_type 防重复，金额服务端带出

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
技师入驻
applied → approved → active
applied → rejected → applied（重新提交）
active ⇄ suspended · active → banned

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Token 认证
issued → active → refreshed → active
active → blacklisted（登出/改密/并发>3）
active → expired（7天未使用）

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
账号注销
active → requested（余额/未完成订单/在途工单拦截 422）
requested → active（取消申请）
requested → closing（满 72h 确认）
匿名化 phone/nickname + status=0

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
技师提现
pending → approved → processing → completed（T+1 微信零钱）
pending → rejected → 退回
店长审核 → 财务确认 两级

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
客服工单
open ⇄ open（后台回复追加）
open → closed（仅本人/仅 open，可选 rating 1-5）

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
转盘抽奖
on → spun → points / balance / coupon / lose
Redis NX + 行锁 + random_int 权重抽取 + client_token 幂等

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
回头客奖励
completed → checked → pending → settled / none
30 天内同技师二次消费 · 同 order_id+type 幂等
